significant_commits.subject: Fix live MVP commerce flow issues

purpose: Reduce the intent-to-catalog gap by turning a shopper request into Shopify-grounded discovery, comparison, exact cart confirmation, and checkout handoff without duplicating Shopify commerce truth.
one_sentence_identity: IntentCart is the Shopify-native runtime foundation for Sage guided selling, with an embedded merchant view, a Theme App Extension widget, multitenant commerce state, validated tools, and Shopify-owned transactions.
product_promise: Turn your Shopify store into an agentic shopping experience.
maturity: Working with limitations - deployed RC foundation, not reliable general production

local.notes: Local product checks pass except formatting and db validation; Shopify CLI requires an active tunnel and external configuration.

preview.platform: No separate durable preview environment verified
preview.evidence: A previous Shopify CLI tunnel is still referenced by the installed embedded app, but the host no longer resolves.

production.shopper_agent: Implemented but blocked by an Anthropic HTTP 400 response

risks.name: Shopify offline access-token rotation persistence
risks.description: Session schema does not store refresh-token fields required for expiring offline tokens. Blocking for a new public multi-merchant app; actual distribution type remains unknown.

risks.name: Live Anthropic failure
risks.description: The production commerce turn reaches MCP but Anthropic returns HTTP 400.

risks.name: Broken embedded Shopify admin
risks.description: The installed application iframe points to an expired Cloudflare tunnel instead of Railway.

risks.name: Sensitive transient parameters in logs
risks.description: Complete request URLs with transient authentication or signature parameters were visible in Railway logs.

risks.name: No high availability
risks.description: One replica, process-local rate limiting, no Redis, worker, distributed lock, or external alerting proof.

risks.name: Cross-region latency
risks.description: Railway runs in US West while Supabase runs in Northern Europe.

risks.name: No full commerce E2E
risks.description: No current installation-to-checkout test proves the live shopper journey.

risks.name: Read-only and partially persisted merchant admin
risks.description: No admin action saves configuration and several schema sections always come from the seed.

risks.name: No versioned CI or immutable release tag
risks.description: Production is deployed from a feature branch and no CI workflow or Git tag was found.

risks.name: Database operations not fully verified
risks.description: Runtime role, exact table grants, backups, PITR, restore procedure, and RPO/RTO were not proven.

risks.name: Undefined privacy and retention
risks.description: No clear retention and consent policy was found for messages, events, tokens, and logs.

risks.name: Incomplete local database environment
risks.description: Prisma validation fails because DIRECT_URL is absent locally.

risks.name: Provider configuration exceeds implementation
risks.description: OpenAI variables exist but only Anthropic is implemented; Kimi is absent.

risks.name: Documentation drift
risks.description: Several documents still describe JSON storage, old chat paths, seven migrations, and no deployment.

risks.name: No visual, load, or recommendation evaluation
risks.description: The repository lacks Playwright, visual regression, load tests, and a relevance benchmark.

risks.name: React Router 8 future flags
risks.description: The production build reports upcoming middleware, route splitting, Vite API, request, and URL changes.

recommended_decision: ADAPT the current repository as Sage's Shopify runtime foundation. Promote the trust boundary, tenant context, strict schemas, and cart-confirmation guardrail; fix the three P0 issues and run a complete live E2E before calling it multi-merchant production.
